Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with
complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with whiplash-type
cervical injury. The mechanism of injury is well matched to the reported symptoms.
Over the cuorse of care the patient attended 21 visits, which is somewhat longer than
typically expected for this type of injury, with treatment including manual therapy,
supervised therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Cervical range of
moiton was restricted on initial examination, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and
reduced strength noted. Imaging and clinical examination findings clearly confirm the
presence of soft tissue injury to the cervical spine. The patient reports no prior
injury or treatment involving the neck or upper back. Billing records reflect single
entries for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated charges identified.
Current status shows gardual improvement in pain and mobility, and the patient has
been discharged to a self-directed home program with follow-up as needed.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
